units.source_text: 我们从岐阜站乘电车到长良川去。

en.t: We took the train from Gifu Station to the Nagara River.

units.source_text: 来到南岸的旅馆门前，老板娘迎出来说：

en.t: When we arrived in front of the inn on the south bank, the proprietress came out to greet us and said:

units.source_text: 前阵子来了一场暴风雨，把二楼和楼下的挡雨板都刮坏了。

en.t: A little while ago, a violent storm came through and tore up the rain shutters on both the second floor and downstairs.
The inn was closed for business.
Could this be an ominous sign?
